article: REMAG: GPU-first SIESTA for magnetic materials

summary.scope: One A100-80GB and 16 reserved CPU cores. Current v178 binary, default tile modes, fresh processes and unchanged saved inputs. More upstream parallel layouts; no claim of exhaustive tuning, production convergence or general SIESTA average.
summary.aggregation_scope: Equal-workflow geometric mean only after all seven declared workflows and all their required upstream solver families pass direct pristine-CPU science/export/convergence checks. Directional x/z pairs count once. Partial results retain explicit coverage, without a full-suite average.

case_timings.scope: Process start through initialization, SCF, final observables and requested exports; excludes build, provisioning and evidence transfer
case_timings.tuning: Repeated timing for this qualified configuration; final selection uses a complete directional pair

workflows.name: Fe2B full-SOC x/z
workflows.failure: Insufficient reserved time for the next complete trial and checkpoint

plan.suite: Expanded known-converging magnetic workflows with native and applicable ELSI finalists
plan.selection: Ten existing physical inputs across seven workflows, selected for demonstrated CPU/candidate convergence before new timing. Four compounds (Fe3C, Fe2B, FePt, Fe5PB2) plus two elemental-Fe controls. Fe4N excluded for known convergence difficulty; all future failures retained.
plan.baseline_selection: Screen allowed solver-only settings. Repeat the fastest passing native finalist and, for each collinear workflow, the fastest passing ELSI finalist three times. Use the lowest median among fully passing finalists. Do not claim a full-suite aggregate if a required family lacks three passing repetitions.
plan.aggregate: Equal-workflow geometric mean only after all seven declared workflows and all their required upstream solver families pass direct pristine-CPU science/export/convergence checks. Directional x/z pairs count once. Partial results retain explicit coverage, without a full-suite average.
plan.scope: One A100-80GB and 16 reserved CPU cores. Current v178 binary, default tile modes, fresh processes and unchanged saved inputs. More upstream parallel layouts; no claim of exhaustive tuning, production convergence or general SIESTA average.
plan.budget_policy: Hard allocation ceiling plus an earlier software deadline; no process begins without enough remaining time for its per-case timeout and checkpoint reserve. No automatic rerun after interruption, cap extension or follow-on GPU launch.
plan.budget_basis: Conservative first-allocation assumption while the optional user budget preference is unanswered. No expansion or follow-on GPU allocation without resolving the remaining campaign budget.

plan.suite: Four previously converged magnetic workflows; selected before new timing results
plan.selection: Existing pristine CPU and candidate convergence with unchanged physics and no case-specific recovery: CPU 47–89 iterations. This does not assert universal convergence.
plan.baseline_selection: Screen established native/ELSI settings sequentially; choose lowest complete workflow wall time among scientifically passing settings; then three fresh repetitions. No claim of exhaustive tuning.
plan.aggregate: Equal-workflow geometric mean of median speedup ratios; also report ratio of sums of workflow medians and per-case range. x/z counts as one workflow. Full-suite aggregate withheld if any predeclared workflow fails.
plan.scope: Single A100-80GB allocation; current v178 numerical binary, default tile modes, fresh processes and unchanged saved inputs. Results describe this suite, not all SIESTA workloads. CPU references validate science only, not performance.
